title: The Quiet Inventory
author: Freya Vasquez
blurb: Isandro Pemberton, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
